parent_comparison.inside_target: frozen zone center, toward-side known at arrival; exact-center arrival WAIT
parent_comparison.outside_target: same parent episode after confirmed departure, first eligible completed-M1 decision, near zone edge
parent_comparison.interpretation: Common parent-contact policy comparison; entry distances and timing differ by design. No equal-payoff treatment-effect claim.

selection: All definitions frozen before the first zone-game run. No winner selection or refitting across dates. This tape was inspected in earlier experiments; no untouched holdout claim.
scope: Absolute fixed grid defines addresses. Qualified historical zones are a subset; outside means outside the selected target, not outside every grid cell. State, episode outcome, geometry and executable PnL remain separate.
